description: Scrape Amazon's Best Sellers, New Releases, Most Wished For, Most Gifted, or Movers & Shakers charts for one or more categories.

categoryNodeIds.description: Amazon browse-node IDs in `rootSlug/nodeId` form (e.g. `electronics/172541` for Headphones). Combined with `categoryUrls` if both are provided.
categoryNodeIds.title: Category node IDs

categoryUrls.description: Amazon category slugs (e.g. `electronics`, `electronics/172541`) or full chart URLs to scrape. Each entry is combined with `chartType` and `domain` to build the chart page.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs or slugs

domain.description: Which Amazon marketplace to scrape the chart from.
domain.title: Amazon domain

includeProductDetails.description: For each chart item, also fetch its product detail page for purchase-option and additional rating data. Slower and bounded by `maxProductDetails`.
includeProductDetails.title: Enrich with product detail page

maxDepth.description: When > 0, also walk each category's left-nav subcategory links this many levels deep, scraping each subcategory's own chart too. 0 = only the given categories.
maxDepth.title: Subcategory recursion depth

maxItems.description: Hard cap on total chart items emitted across all categories in this run.
maxItems.title: Max total items

maxItemsPerCategory.description: Hard cap on chart items emitted per category (across all its pages).
maxItemsPerCategory.title: Max items per category

maxPages.description: Maximum number of chart pages to fetch per category, starting at `startPage`.
maxPages.title: Max pages per category

maxProductDetails.description: Hard cap on how many chart items get product-detail enrichment when `includeProductDetails` is on.
maxProductDetails.title: Max product detail fetches

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used to fetch chart pages. Datacenter (AUTO) is used by default and works for most requests; the actor escalates to residential only after repeated blocks on a session.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

startPage.description: First chart page to fetch (each page is a separate ranked page on Amazon's site, not a fixed rank count).
startPage.title: Start page

title: Amazon Best Sellers & Rankings Scraper Input
